transcript.text: Good morning. Let's get started with the maintenance-priority board. We have one replacement controller available today, and it can go to only one of three systems: generator G-7, water purification unit W-2, or clinic refrigeration bank R-1. I need each of you to report your current section constraints so we can make the right call on where this controller gets installed. S-4, let's start with you — what are you seeing on your end?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to bring something to the board's attention. This morning S-4 confirmed that W-2 has a compatible on-hand spare filter assembly that will keep the water purifier operational for seven days. W-2 does not require the scarce replacement controller today. The inventory adjustment is recorded in the logistics system, but it hadn't been brought to the priority board yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I need to report a critical constraint from the maintenance shop. Our inspection found that G-7's controller is failing and must be replaced today. The installation takes exactly four hours and can be completed from 1200 to 1600. I should note that this inspection result is still in our shop worksheet and has not yet been entered into the battalion work-order summary, which is why it hasn't surfaced until now.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Sir, I need to report the current status of clinic refrigeration bank R-1. R-1 is currently operating within limits and does not require the replacement controller today. Its compatible controller is backordered until exactly 18 June — I confirmed the date with the medical depot this morning. However, the backorder notice has not yet been attached to the maintenance action record, which is why this hasn't surfaced until now.
transcript.speaker: A4
